primary_program_definitions.text: Global Depositary Shares evidenced by Global Depositary Receipts, each Global Depositary Share representing 1 share of Series III Convertible Preferred Stock of Philippine Long Distance Telephone Company

independent_judgment: The governing registration-fee securities description explicitly registers one preferred share per Global Depositary Share. The primary deposited unit is preferred stock, and preferred-stock agreements are the operative exhibits. This is not an ordinary-share ADS entitlement.
